_comment: Stands in for GET /settings, which the dongle serves from
firmware/main/settings.c. The console fetches it at load, so without it
the harness would 404 on every run -- which is how this file came to
exist: the runner's own 404 guard caught it on the first run.
Deliberately minimal. The checks here are about the wire protocol, not
the settings panel, and a fixture that mirrored the full device document
would be a second copy of it drifting against firmware/main/settings.c.
usb_disk is true so the page renders its default composition rather than
a variant, keeping the DOM the checks touch in its ordinary state.
